visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two Corgi dogs sit side-by-side at a high wooden bar counter. The Corgi on the left is dressed in a tiny maroon waiter's vest, while the Corgi on the right wears a similar vest in dark green. Behind them, a warm glow emanates from a neon sign reading 'Bark & Brew' mounted above shelves of assorted glass bottles. (2) The Corgi in the maroon vest uses its front paws to lift a small, round pastry topped with thick white frosting toward the camera. The Corgi in the green vest turns its head sharply, its eyes widening and its mouth opening in a look of exaggerated, wide-eyed anticipation as it watches the pastry. (3) The pastry is suddenly launched through the air in a quick, blurry arc toward the right side of the frame. It makes direct, messy contact with the face of the Corgi in the green vest, causing white cream to splatter across its snout, forehead, and around its eyes. (4) The Corgi in the maroon vest raises its left paw in a human-like 'thumbs-up' gesture while maintaining a happy, open-mouthed expression. The Corgi in the green vest remains perfectly still, its face now completely coated in white frosting, staring forward with a dazed and shocked expression.
